name: night-watch
description: Re-runs the Send Payment journey every night in scripted mode. The broken variant must be blocked and the fixed variant must pass. If the fixed variant fails, it reports a returning ghost.
author: Haunted Audit team

crons.name: night-watch-nightly
crons.message: Call the run_night_watch tool exactly once. If the outcome is all_as_expected, reply with exactly one line of plain text and take no further action. If the outcome is returning_ghost or could_not_check, follow night_watch/report_agent/prompt.md.
